sources: NASA Turbulence Modeling Resource, 2D Bump-in-channel Verification Case, SA results, https://tmbwg.github.io/turbmodels/bump_sa.html
role: numerical RANS solutions on the 1409 x 641 grid from CFL3D and FUN3D; not measurements
format: Tecplot ASCII, unmodified from the source, with one zone per code and two columns: x and the coefficient
flow: M = 0.2, Re = 3 million per unit grid length, viscous wall from x = 0 to 1.5, bump y = 0.05 sin(pi x/0.9 - pi/3)^4 on 0.3 <= x <= 1.2
turbulence: SA with farfield nu_tilde = 3 nu; the source states that SA-noft2 gives essentially identical results for this case
